from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
p = Path('opsd_de_load.csv')
print(f'exists={p.exists()} size={p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None}')
df = pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=['utc_timestamp'])
col = 'DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency'
print(f'rows={len(df)} columns={list(df.columns)}')
print(f'first={df.utc_timestamp.iloc[0].isoformat()} last={df.utc_timestamp.iloc[-1].isoformat()}')
print(f'nan={int(df.isna().sum().sum())} duplicate_ts={int(df.utc_timestamp.duplicated().sum())}')
deltas = df.utc_timestamp.diff().dropna()
print(f'non_hourly_gaps={int((deltas != pd.Timedelta(hours=1)).sum())}')
for label, lo, hi in [
    ('train','2015-01-01 00:00','2019-09-30 23:00'),
    ('validation','2019-10-01 00:00','2019-12-31 23:00'),
    ('test','2020-01-01 00:00','2020-01-07 23:00'),
]:
    mask = df.utc_timestamp.between(pd.Timestamp(lo, tz='UTC'), pd.Timestamp(hi, tz='UTC'))
    print(f'{label}_rows={int(mask.sum())}')
print(f'load_min={df[col].min()} load_max={df[col].max()} load_mean={df[col].mean()}')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
p = pd.read_csv('opsd_de_load.csv', parse_dates=['utc_timestamp']).set_index('utc_timestamp')['DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency']
y = p.loc['2020-01-01':'2020-01-07 23:00']
f = p.shift(168).loc[y.index]
print('naive MAPE', np.mean(np.abs((y-f)/y))*100)
print('Jan1', np.mean(np.abs((y.iloc[:24]-f.iloc[:24])/y.iloc[:24]))*100)
print('Jan2-7', np.mean(np.abs((y.iloc[24:]-f.iloc[24:])/y.iloc[24:]))*100)
